name: Kaze Yoga
description: A calm, airy theme for small yoga studios: a pale mist ground with sage and pine-ink, Gowun Batang headings and Lexend text, and a slow breath line (a soft drifting wave) as the signature; a header that is only the wordmark and a Menu button opening a full-screen numbered menu; a home page told in four chapters where each photograph stays while its words scroll past; a footer that is one big band inviting visitors to book a free trial class above the studio details; with about, a weekly timetable, the teachers, a trial class with a booking form, a journal, a newsletter and contact. The studio details and the timetable are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, chapter numbers, the open menu and prices
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2021 The Gowun Batang Project Authors

fonts.role: body text, labels, the timetable, navigation, forms and buttons
